scope: Bounded preflight of explicit-anchor merge ranges, applicable to TABLE output versions admitted by the writer; selected AC1018 tests exercise bounds, overlap and rollback.

preFixReproductions.input: Locally authored 1x3 AC1018 table with unit source descriptors, modified in memory. Out-of-bounds: anchor column 1 width 3 and range columns 1 through 3. Overlap: anchors columns 0 and 1 each width 2 with ranges 0..1 and 1..2.
preFixReproductions.result: Both exported successfully but reimported as semanticContentComplete=0 with no merged ranges.

postFixReproduction.result: Both malformed cases refused with sentinel and tested model fields unchanged; same-writer corrected retry succeeds and readback is complete with one range.

implementation: Validate explicit rectangles and anchor descriptors, with bounded grid occupancy and immediate overlap refusal; reject zero non-anchor descriptors in merged grids to avoid normalizing retained data. With zero merged cells and ranges the occupancy vector is empty.

controls.coverage: ASCII and binary inputs and outputs, strict and compatible modes; 8 valid explicit-anchor and 8 unmerged baseline round trips, 64 malformed-profile atomic refusals with 64 corrected retries.
controls.faults: Horizontal and vertical overflow, overlap, duplicate and mismatching ranges, negative bounds, and zero non-anchor width or height. Caller identity/body and destination sentinel are checked.

normalValidation.result: 9/9 passed as reported; no retained test-log hash asserted.

asanValidation.result: 9/9 passed as reported; no retained test-log hash asserted.

simultaneousWork.chronology: BLOCK_RECORD adapter source was frozen but uncommitted during both normal and ASan builds, then committed as 2eafb121.

limitations: This establishes selected writer refusal and typed readback, not native merge rendering semantics or general TABLE support.
